name: Pennsylvania Championship 2022
information: # Please see the [COVID-19 tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PennsylvaniaChampionship2022#17518-covid-19-safety-must-read) for important safety information! # Maximum one spectator per competitor. We are very excited to announce the inaugural Pennsylvania Championship! Join us for a very sweet weekend of cubing and fun in historic Hershey Pennsylvania. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations Live results can be found on our WCA Live page, which will be available during the competition. Before registering, you must read the "Competitor Information" tab. This tab details the responsibilites of all competitors at this competition.
